title: feat(console): a Mobile App page in the account app shows the code that connects the ObjectOS mobile app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91YSeH3thYWBG8zdtU9ZDBB)_

Fixes #29314

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a new account-app navigation entry and component (`account:mobile_app`), a new `mobileApp` namespace in the `@object-ui/i18n` packs, and a new optional `features.publicBaseUrl` served on `GET /api/v1/auth/config` (declared in `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema`, registered in `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS`, typed on `AuthPublicConfig`); nothing that worked before is refused
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `features.publicBaseUrl` is a key the server serves on its public auth config; no metadata author writes it, and no skill teaches the auth config payload

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：个人设置（头像菜单 → Profile 所在的 account 应用）在 Profile 之后新增「移动应用」页，显示二维码和可复制的连接链接 `objectos://connect?server=<本服务器公开地址>`；服务端 `GET /api/v1/auth/config` 新增 `features.publicBaseUrl`，就是服务器发邮件、OAuth 链接时用的那个公开地址（只含 scheme、host、路径）。
- 为什么改：用户装好 ObjectOS 手机 App 后，要扫码连到自己的服务器；现在只能手敲地址。
- 风险与回滚：匿名接口多了一个地址字段，但凭据、query、fragment 在服务端和页面两头都会去掉；地址是 localhost / 内网、或公网却只走 http 时不出码，提示把 `OS_AUTH_URL` 设成 https 公网地址；从不用浏览器当前地址。spec 因新增键按规则升 minor。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/public-base-url.ts`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/mobile-app/mobileConnect.ts`、`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/public-base-url.test.ts` 应 10 个测试全过（含走真实 `/api/v1/auth/config` 的两条）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Server.**

- `GET /api/v1/auth/config` serves `features.publicBaseUrl`: `publicBaseUrlOf(getCanonicalOrigin())`, the canonical origin every emailed and OAuth link is built on (`OS_AUTH_URL`, then `BETTER_AUTH_URL`, then `OS_BASE_URL`; sub-path kept; `https://` prepended to a bare host; the loopback fallback when unset).
- `publicBaseUrlOf` (new, `plugin-auth`) reduces it to an address: scheme, host (with a non-default port) and path, no trailing slash. A username, password, query or fragment is dropped, because the door is anonymous. A value that does not parse as an absolute URL is not served.
- `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema.publicBaseUrl` (optional string, with a describe), `'publicBaseUrl'` appended to `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS`, and the regenerated `auth-endpoints.mdx` reference and `authorable-surface/api.json` baseline.

**Console.**

- `MobileAppPage` (new, `@object-ui/app-shell`, lazy-loaded) reads `features.publicBaseUrl` through `useAuth().getAuthConfig()` and judges it with `mobileConnectTarget`:
  - `ready`: a public host on `https:`. A QR code (the existing `qrcode` dependency, as an SVG `data:` image on a white frame), the same link as copyable text with **Copy link**, and one privacy line.
  - `unreachable` / `not-public`: `localhost`, a loopback, private, link-local or otherwise non-public host, or a scheme other than http(s). No code; the alert names the address and says to set `OS_AUTH_URL` to the public address.
  - `unreachable` / `not-https`: a public host on plain `http:`. The mobile app signs in through this address, so no code; the alert says to serve the server over HTTPS and set `OS_AUTH_URL` to its `https://` address.
  - `unpublished`: the key is absent, blank or not an absolute URL (the raw value is never shown). The alert says this server does not offer it yet; no setting is named, because none can fix it.
  - A failed config read shows its own message. `window.location` is never read.
- The payload is `objectos://connect?server=` plus the URL-encoded `normalizeServerUrl(publicBaseUrl)`: the same address-only normalisation, applied again on the console side, so the code and every refusal carry the server's address and nothing else.
- `deploymentReach`: the new `isPublicHostAddress` is scheme-agnostic; `isPublicHttpsAddress` keeps its behaviour by parsing the URL, requiring `https:`, and delegating. The Connect Agent widget is unchanged.
- `registerAppComponent({ ref: 'account:mobile_app', … })` in `builtinComponents`; `AuthPublicConfig.features.publicBaseUrl?: string` in `@object-ui/auth`.
- `packages/platform-objects` account app: `nav_account_mobile_app` (component nav, `componentRef: 'account:mobile_app'`, icon `smartphone`) right after Profile, with its label in all 11 app translation bundles.
- A `mobileApp` namespace (15 keys) in the 10 hand-written `@object-ui/i18n` packs; `zh-Hant` regenerated with `scripts/gen-zh-hant.mjs`.
- No app-store links: no setting carries them today.

## Tests

- `public-base-url.test.ts` (plugin-auth): over the REAL `registerAuthRoutes` on a Hono app over a real `AuthManager`, `GET /api/v1/auth/config` serves the configured URL with its sub-path, and a configured credential, query and fragment are absent from the whole response body; `getPublicConfig()` follows `getCanonicalOrigin` (bare host, trailing slash) with a CONTROL for the loopback fallback; `publicBaseUrlOf` cases, including an unparseable value served as nothing.
- `mobileConnect.test.ts`: the payload for a public URL, a sub-path and a port; 13 loopback / private / link-local addresses refused as `not-public`; another scheme refused without its credential; a public `http:` host refused as `not-https`, with a CONTROL on `https:`; eight inputs (credentials, query, fragment, trailing slash, whitespace, case, default port) normalised; the link's only parameter is `server`; a value that is not an absolute URL reads as `unpublished`.
- `MobileAppPage.test.tsx`: the image `src` equals `qrcode`'s own SVG for the expected link; a credential, query or fragment reaches neither the code nor the page; Copy writes exactly the link; the not-public, not-https and unpublished refusals with their keys and values (the unpublished one names no `OS_AUTH_URL`); the failed read; every built-in locale carries every `mobileApp` key with the same placeholders; `account:mobile_app` resolves through the component registry to this page.
- `account-mobile-app-nav.test.ts` (platform-objects): `nav_account_mobile_app` sits immediately after `nav_account_profile`, opens `account:mobile_app` and carries no gate, with a CONTROL that the app still parses.
- `ui/e2e/mobile-app-connect-qr.spec.ts` (Playwright): the QR image decodes (`naturalWidth > 0`) at ≥150px beside the link, Copy button and privacy line; a CONTROL with a loopback URL shows the `OS_AUTH_URL` remedy and no code.
- Ablations, each red then green after restore: the raw canonical origin served (1 failed); the key not served (4 failed); no console-side normalisation (12 failed); a public `http:` host treated as ready (2 failed); the registered ref renamed (1 failed); the nav entry moved before Profile (1 failed); and, in the first round, the refusal predicate removed (16), the sub-path dropped (3), a `window.location` fallback (1), a broken image `src` (the e2e image test).
- Forced test edits, three, each because this PR adds a key or an entry on purpose:
  - `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`: the account app's served nav ids count 14, not 13 (`nav_account_mobile_app`).
  - `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.test.ts`: the served `features` fixture gains `publicBaseUrl`, because the test requires it to name every classified key.
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.test.ts`: the exact `getPublicConfig().features` expectation gains `publicBaseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000'`.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface deviations, seat-approved: the account app (`account.app.ts`) and its 11 translation bundles for the nav entry; the server half in `auth-endpoints.zod.ts` and `auth-manager.ts`, added after #34119 and #34099 merged, plus the new `public-base-url.ts`.
- Grading: the claim's `Metadata-protocol: none` is now `added`. The new key moves the `authorable-surface/api.json` baseline, and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `none` with a moved baseline, so `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` are `minor`; the `@object-ui/*` packages stay `patch`.
- The account app has no separate "user settings" page; the account app reached from the avatar menu's Profile item is that surface.
- Cloud-agnostic: nothing here reads a Cloud setting; a Cloud deployment publishes its URL through the same `OS_AUTH_URL`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on the final record at `7c7c5ba4`: "125 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". All 125 exit 0.
- The round before it, at `cacb7dd1`, had three reds: `check:test-source-alias` (a finding: the page test's registry check reaches the metadata admin's dynamic `@objectstack/lint` import inside a clocked window; fixed in `7c7c5ba4` by the module-top import the gate prescribes), and `check:dts-closure` plus `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (both read `ui/` build output that was stale after merging `main`; green after rebuilding the ui packages).
- Suites at the server-half head under the lock: `@objectstack/spec` 844 files, 26993 tests (one red fixed: the served-features fixture, listed above); `@objectstack/plugin-auth` 278 files (one red fixed: the exact `features` expectation); `@objectstack/platform-objects` 123 files, 2010 passed. The mobile-app vitest (47) and the Playwright spec (2) pass on the UI changes; app-shell `tsc` and eslint are clean.
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --event` on this body offline: level axis green with `Metadata-protocol: added` and every moved package graded `minor`.
- Earlier rounds: 69 at `58280860` and 71 at `9cebce86`, all exit 0.
- Records: project share `ui-seat1/29314-gates-ran-final.txt`, `ui-seat1/29314-gates-ran-r4.txt`, `ui-seat1/29314-ablations-r2.log`.

</details>
